stories.title: Home Office changes Gronant asylum seeker housing plan after review
stories.summary: Major changes have been made to an asylum seeker housing plan in Gronant following a Home Office review. stories.title: Retailers warn Saturday jobs at risk under employment law changes
stories.summary: Four in five UK adults believe Saturday jobs and other part-time work help young people into employment, according to polling for the British Retail Consortium. stories.title: Collision closed A494 at Ewloe for two hours overnight
stories.summary: The A494 at Ewloe was closed for around two hours overnight after a two-vehicle collision on the eastbound carriageway. North Wales Police said officers were called just before 12.30am on Monday 17 August.
